correctness.rationale: For every field and N>=3, the relation x^2=0 makes the tangent projection upper triangular. The four tangent idempotent cases force augmentation, identity, short-branch dual-number images, or long-branch N-dimensional graph subalgebras. The latter have kernels k(x-t y^(N-1)). Substitution proves the unique normal forms and the if-and-only-if cross-commutation condition a=-c and h=-t y^(N-1); same-family distinct maps do not commute. Independent exhaustive enumeration from original ring relations over fields of orders 2,3,4,5 and N up to 6 matches the forms, ranks, graph, and pair counts. Finite checks are supplementary, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural simplest unequal-length fiber product of two principal local Artin rings exhibits an exact compatibility obstruction not determined by its total endomorphism count. The theorem classifies all retractions for unbounded N, distinguishes the two image dimensions, identifies every complementary commuting pair, and proves a sharp N=3 versus N>=4 onset of isolated dual-number retractions. The full graph and clique/pair-count polynomials supply structural compatibility data for split algebra retracts, not an arbitrary selected parameter or routine input substitution.
